cohort: The study included 415 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with placenta previa, comprising 119 in the placenta accreta spectrum group and 296 in the control group without placental invasion.
finding: Red cell distribution width (RDW) and neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) serve as useful auxiliary indicators for predicting placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), although increases in SIRI values were not statistically significant.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean sections was higher in the placenta accreta spectrum group compared to the control group.
gest_age: Gestational age was lower in the PAS group, but no specific range for the cohort is provided.
